ns2:group.ns2:title: Turn your AirPods into a camera remote for iPhone. #Shorts
ns2:group.ns2:description:
@hackphonex demonstrates how to turn your AirPods into a camera remote for your iPhone. Here’s how it’s done ⬇️
• In Settings, open your AirPods options toward the top of the list • Scroll down and tap Camera Remote, then tap Press Once • Next, open the Camera App • Now, with your AirPods in your ears, simply tap the stem to take a picture
AirPods 4, AirPods Pro 2, or AirPods Pro 3 required.
Created by @hackphonex. Shared by Apple.
Music: "Magnetic" - Jam City
